# AI-assisted contributions

AI-assisted contributions are welcome when a human contributor reviews,
understands, tests, and accepts responsibility for every submitted change.

Do not submit unattended bulk changes, fabricated test results, unverifiable
claims, copied material without compatible licensing, or secrets. Disclose
material AI assistance in the pull-request description. AI tools are not
authors and should not appear in `Co-authored-by` trailers.

Maintainers may close submissions that the contributor cannot explain or that
create disproportionate review work.
